{{Top}}
[[File:ProbotPod-MoTESB.png|thumb|right|250px|A Probe-Mate hyperspace pod]]
A '''hyperdrive pod''', also known as a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] pod was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-controlled [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]-equipped pod that delivered [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] to their destinations.<ref name="DFRSB">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Once the pod exited hyperspace, it would crash onto a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface, breaking apart and allowing the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to exit the pod and begin its assigned mission.

The [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] utilized two models, both developed by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]; the [[Predator I]],<ref name="DFRSB" /> and the [[Probe-Mate hyperspace pod]].<ref name="GG3-2">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref>

The [[Spelunker probe droid/Legends|Spelunker probe droid]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] were deployed by hyperdrive pods in their travels.

The [[Seeker Transport]] hyperdrive pod was used to transport the [[Seeker AS-M12 message droid|AS-M12-series messenger droid]] to its destination.<ref name="SOTE SB">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The model for the hyperdrive pod used on-screen in ''[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back]]'' were created by [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kitbashing kitbashing] the models of five [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Schwerer_Panzersp%C3%A4hwagen Sd. Kfz. 232s].<ref>''[[Star Wars Chronicles Episode IV, V and VI Vehicles]]''</ref>
